Retain those source silhouette blocks and raised hands, their actual left/middle/right placement and the clothed rear standing group. Do not replace the crowd by uniformly posed mascot rows.
Lock the rounded arch, supporting columns, warm wooden balcony, exact blue seat blocks, angled flanking desks and pale central/right aisle perspective. Keep the large foreground RIGHT desk with its source paper forms and the original visible empty floor. No naked mascot in the aisle, new person, moved table, straight transverse desk blocking the aisle, centered solo character or changed room.
Final output is the complete Image1 card with its actual tilted narrow dark photograph frame and wholly solid photographic backing, plus the overlapping beige note at its original right position covering the same photo area. Keep the TWO compact upper dark mark rows/groups as indistinct strokes with original footprint/contrast, and blank paper elsewhere. No newly readable writing. Preserve original aspect ratio/crop, dark source lighting and full generated detail. Genuine exterior transparency only outside the whole original frame-and-note silhouette; all scene/clothing/backing/note interiors solid. No comparison board, auxiliary photo panel, labels, watermark or markings.
